summary: In a fiction excerpt from Book 1 (part 189), the narrator Marcus is freed from a torture room when body-armored officers, identified as California State Troopers (CHP), arrest his captors and unstrap him. Barbara Stratford, who had been held back in the corridor, embraces him, and he showers off. Barbara reveals that his parents are not present, that everyone at the site is still under arrest and must be processed through the criminal justice system, and that release on bail may come quickly though the process could take months.
one_line: Marcus is rescued from a torture room by California State Troopers and reunited with Barbara Stratford, but learns he remains under arrest and his parents are absent.
key_facts: Officers in body armor, helmets, and smoked-plastic visors shouted "Stand down!" at the Treasure Island guards and ordered them to put their hands in the air.
A body-armored officer batted Severe Haircut woman's phone away with a gloved hand, and it clattered to the ground in a shower of parts.
Two officers turned Severe Haircut woman around and fastened plastic handcuffs around her wrists.
An officer with a video camera on his shoulder, a rig with blinding white light, filmed the whole room, circling the narrator twice.
The rescuing officers wore red crosses on their shoulders and helmets, with the insignia CHP beneath them, identifying them as California Highway Patrol State Troopers.
Barbara Stratford had been held back in the corridor before coming into the room, pushing and shoving, and embraced the narrator in a long, hard hug.
The narrator used the working shower head to rinse off, feeling embarrassed to be covered in piss and barf.
Barbara Stratford was in tears when the narrator finished showering and asked about his parents.
Barbara said the narrator's parents were not there and that "It's complicated."
Barbara told the narrator, "You're still under arrest, Marcus. Everyone here is."
Barbara said everyone at the site must be processed through the criminal justice system, which could take months.
Barbara expected the narrator to be arraigned and released on bail pretty fast.
The excerpt includes an unrelated aside that in 2013 Mandy saw the original 'Garden of Earthly Delights' painting up close after waiting in line for hours.
